newsitem.title: UK: LONDON INTERNATIONAL SAYS BUSINESS GROWING. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: LONDON INTERNATIONAL SAYS BUSINESS GROWING. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT]

text.p: British healthcare and protection products company London International Group Plc said on Thursday that growth continued in all its core businesses but currency volatility remained a problem.
The company said in a statement to shareholders it was making progress on converting and upgrading its U.S. manufacturing plants to make powder-free examination gloves.
London International said its Durex Avanti (corrects from Duress Amanita) condom, the world's first polyurethane condom for men, had been well accepted by British retailers.
The company said it was confident of receiving full clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for Durex Avanti (corrects). --London Newsroom +44 171 542 4017
